svg.text: Roof plan, cut at +6.00 · grid B
horizontal cut through the roof, looking down on the ribs
Cut at +6.00 (3500 above the eave, just below the
horizontal rib at +6.13): printed layers, air zone,
cast ribs cut (crossed hatch), outer layer,
insulation 100 and outer layer 30.
Ribs of grid B seen below the cut: the two families
of diagonals from the base ring at the eave up to
the cut and the hips.
Base ring: the 300 solid base at the eave (+2.50 to
No horizontal ribs in grid B between the base ring
and the top ring.
Hips: ribs from the corners of the eave up to the
cut; dashed above it, up to the crown opening.
Roof edge at the eave (outside of the 30 outer
layer). Very faint squares = printed layer joints
(real layers 10, drawn every 200 in height).
Above the cut (removed, dashed): hips and the crown
opening at +8.50, 1000 clear inside (1400 at the
middle of the shell, 2125 outside the outer layer).
Buttresses below the roof: their ends show beyond
the roof edge; the wall under the roof is dashed.

Notes
Matches the roof-grid elevations: same rib geometry, same
levels (+4.31, +6.13, +7.77 for the horizontal ribs of
grid A).
The ribs lie inside the shell, between the printed inner
layers and the outer layer; here they are drawn as if the
outer layer, insulation and cladding were transparent.
